tokenText:
I've created the three files for your simple todo list app in the current root directory:

1.  **`index.html`**: Sets up the basic structure with an input field, an "Add" button, and an empty list.
2.  **`style.css`**: Provides a clean, centered layout with styling for the todo items and their completed states.
3.  **`app.js`**: Contains the logic for adding new tasks, toggling completion, and deleting items.

You can now open `index.html` in any web browser to use the app.
